title: fix(cli,create-objectstack): scaffolds declare vitest ~4.1.12, outside GHSA-qxg6-89mg-rqv8, and still install on npm 10
body:
Fixes #25165

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What this does

- `SCAFFOLD_VITEST_RANGE` in `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts` moves from `~4.0.0` to `~4.1.12`. `os init -t plugin` and `os create plugin` declare it in `devDependencies`. `SCAFFOLD_NPM_OVERRIDES`, which is built from it, puts it in the `overrides` of every standalone `os init` / `os create plugin` manifest. The override's shape is unchanged.
- The blank template's `devDependencies.vitest` and `overrides.vitest` are re-stamped from that constant by the write run of `scripts/sync-scaffold-emission-policy.mjs`, the same run `create-objectstack`'s `build` invokes. Both scaffolders read one constant, and no value is kept by hand.
- A floor pin in `packages/cli/test/scaffold-npm-overrides.test.ts`: the range's lowest admitted version must be at or above the advisory fix for its major (4.1.12 on 4.x, 5.0.3 on 5.x). A major with no row is refused, not passed.
- The comments on the constant, the override and the template test carry the new measurement.
- `.changeset/25165-scaffold-vitest-advisory.md` bumps `@objectstack/cli` and `create-objectstack` at `patch` and gives the one-line move for existing projects.
- `content/docs/deployment/troubleshooting.mdx` (patch round): the npm 10 `edgesOut` entry's fix 2 prescribed `overrides.vitest` `~4.0.0`, which installs vitest 4.0.18, inside the advisory. It now prescribes `~4.1.12`. The entry names vitest 4.1.12's contradictory optional peer as the cause, says a direct `vitest` devDependency must move with the override (`EOVERRIDE`), and says how an existing `~4.0.0` project moves.

## The advisory

I read the advisory from the npm registry's bulk advisory endpoint (`registry.npmjs.org/-/npm/v1/security/advisories/bulk`, 2026-10-22). This container's egress proxy refuses `api.osv.dev` (403 at CONNECT).

- **GHSA-qxg6-89mg-rqv8**, `@vitest/mocker`: affected from 2.1.0-beta.7 up to the fix in 4.1.12, and from 5.0.0-beta.1 up to the fix in 5.0.3. That confirms the card's range.
- **Also on the baseline.** `npm audit` of a baseline scaffold (`~4.0.0`, which resolves vitest and `@vitest/mocker` to 4.0.18) also lists:
  - GHSA-82fw-gwwq-j7x9 (`@vitest/mocker`, from 2.1.0 up to the fix in 4.1.11);
  - GHSA-5xrq-8626-4rwp (`vitest`, critical, from 4.0.0 up to the fix in 4.1.0).
- **What the new floor clears.** It clears all three, and GHSA-xp26-3454-mjgp, which affects exactly 4.1.11 on the 4.x line.

## Route measurements

**Method.**
- Each manifest was installed in its own empty directory, with a fresh `--cache` for every leg.
- The `@objectstack/*` ranges are `^18.0.0`, which resolves to the published 18.0.0.
- After each install I read `vitest` and every `@vitest/mocker` copy from `node_modules`, then ran `npm audit --json`.

**Manifests.**
- The blank template. For route B its bytes equal this PR's stamped template.
- The `os init -t plugin`, `os create plugin`, `os init -t app` and `os init -t empty` manifests. Their dependency blocks are byte-equal to what this branch's source emits, driven through `packages/cli/bin/run-dev.js`.

**npm versions.** 10.9.9 (the newest 10.x), 10.9.4 (the npm bundled with this container's Node 22) and 11.21.1 (the newest 11.x).

In the table, "4.1.12" means the tree holds exactly one `vitest` and one `@vitest/mocker`, both at that version.

| Route | Manifest | npm 10.9.9 | npm 11.21.1 | npm 10.9.4 |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Baseline: `~4.0.0` + override | blank | exit 0 · 4.0.18 · audit lists the 3 advisories above | not measured | not measured |
| Baseline | `os init -t plugin`, `os create plugin` | exit 0 · 4.0.18 · audit lists them | exit 0 · 4.0.18 · audit lists them | not measured |
| A: `~4.1.12`, no override | blank, `os init -t plugin`, `os create plugin` | **exit 1**, `Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')` | blank: exit 0 · 4.1.12 | not measured |
| A | `os init -t app` (declares no vitest), no override | **exit 1**, `edgesOut` | not measured | not measured |
| **B, chosen: `~4.1.12` + override** | blank, `os init -t plugin`, `os create plugin` | exit 0 · 4.1.12 · audit: no `vitest` / `@vitest/*` entry | exit 0 · the same | exit 0 · the same |
| B | `os init -t app`, `os init -t empty` | exit 0 · no vitest installed · audit: none | exit 0 · the same | not measured |
| C: `^5.0.5`, no override | blank | **exit 1**, `edgesOut` | exit 0 · 5.0.5 at the root plus a nested 4.1.12 | not measured |
| D: `^5.0.5` + override | blank, `os init -t plugin`, `os create plugin` | exit 0 · 5.0.5 · audit: no vitest entry | exit 0 · the same | not measured |
| D′: exact `5.0.4` + override (simulates `latest` having moved past the range) | blank | exit 0 · 5.0.4 | exit 0 · 5.0.4 | not measured |

`os create plugin` audits to 0 entries on routes B and D. The other manifests keep 9 moderate entries on every route, and all 9 trace to one advisory: GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq on `uuid` 8.x, reached through `exceljs` from `@objectstack/rest` (see Acceptance notes).

## Why route B holds on npm 10

- **The crash comes from vitest 4.1.12's own peer set.** It peers `@vitest/browser-webdriverio ^4.1.11`, and that package's only release, 4.1.11, peers `vitest: 4.1.11` exactly. With the range at `~4.1.12`, the root vitest reaches that peer set directly, so route A crashes every manifest that declares vitest. `-t app` crashes too, through optional vitest peers deeper in its closure.
- **The `vitest` override alone settles it.** With `overrides.vitest` equal to the declared range, npm 10.9.4 and 10.9.9 install every manifest. No `@vitest/browser-webdriverio` override is needed. The override is the existing `SCAFFOLD_NPM_OVERRIDES` mechanism, unchanged in shape.
- **It does not depend on where `latest` points.** `latest` is vitest 5.0.5, outside `~4.1.12`, and the range still installs. The old comment's reading against `^5.0.0` ("installs only because it resolves to exactly the version `latest` names") was taken without an override. With the override, an exact pin below `latest` (5.0.4) installs too.
- **#24462's canary.** On npm 10.9.9 the full blank template (every template file, with this PR's `package.json`):
  - installs with exit 0;
  - passes `npm test`: `RUN v4.1.12`, `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 1 passed (1)`;
  - builds with `npm run build`, exit 0, `Artifact: dist/objectstack.json`.

  The canary installs published artifacts, so it reads this change only after a release.
- **The plugin scaffolds.** Each was emitted from this branch's source and installed on npm 10.9.9 (vitest and `@vitest/mocker` 4.1.12). `npm run build` and `npm run typecheck` exit 0 for both. Their `npm test` result is in Acceptance notes.

## Why 4.1.x and not 5.x

Routes B and D both install on npm 10 and npm 11, and both clear the advisory. On the four axes:

- **Business need.** The scaffold's test (`note.test.ts`) needs nothing from vitest 5. vitest 5.0.5 declares `engines.node` `^22.12.0 || ^24.0.0 || >=26.0.0`, which is narrower than the `>=22.0.0` that `@objectstack/cli` and `create-objectstack` declare. vitest 4.1.12 declares `^20.0.0 || ^22.0.0 || >=24.0.0`, the same as 4.0.18. So only route D gives a new project on Node 22.0 to 22.11 an engine warning, or a refusal under `engine-strict`.
- **Long-term.** The monorepo's own manifests run `vitest ^4.1.11`, re-locked to 4.1.12 for the same advisory family (#25163). A scaffold on that line runs the vitest the platform is tested with. Moving to 5 is a deliberate change of its own, for the monorepo and the scaffolds together.
- **AI error-proofing.** A patch-line move inside major 4 changes no API that a generated test can call. The floor pin turns a move below the fix into a red test instead of a quiet regression.
- **Startup scope.** This is the smallest change that clears the advisory: one constant, its stamp and its pin.

## Tests (head `4eb2ff4c4`)

- **CLI unit tier.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`, run under the verify lock.
  - First run: `VERDICT command-exit 1`, `Test Files 2 failed | 320 passed (322)`, `Tests 4728 passed | 29 skipped`.
  - Both failures were `test/published-subpath-console.pin.test.ts` and `test/published-subpath-hook-body.pin.test.ts` refusing an unbuilt `packages/cli/dist`: a missing build, not a test failure.
  - After the package build, those two files plus `test/scaffold-npm-overrides.test.ts` (verbose): `VERDICT command-exit 0`, `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 41 passed (41)`. That run includes the new floor case: `its lowest admitted version is at or above the advisory fix for its major`.
  - The integration tier is left to CI: the diff touches no spawn entry and no integration-tier file.
- **create-objectstack.** `pnpm --filter create-objectstack test`: `Test Files 18 passed (18)`, `Tests 278 passed (278)`.
- **Typecheck.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck && pnpm --filter create-objectstack typecheck`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` in `packages/cli` lists `scaffold-npm-overrides.test.ts` once. `create-objectstack`'s `tsc --listFiles` lists `template-consistency.test.ts` once.
- **ESLint.** `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the 3 changed TypeScript files: exit 0.
- **Ablation of the floor pin.** The fix was committed first, and the mutation ran through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode.
  - Mutation: `SCAFFOLD_VITEST_RANGE = '~4.1.12'` became `'~4.0.0'`. The anchor went from 1 to 0 hits, and the blob changed from `47a2518d9a21` to `8da3d5de0b48`.
  - Result: `Tests 1 failed | 11 passed (12)`, with `SCAFFOLD_VITEST_RANGE "~4.0.0" admits 4.0.0, below the fix 4.1.12`. The 11 derived-equality cases stay green under the mutation, which is why the floor pin is needed.
  - Restore: the blob equals the HEAD blob (`47a2518d9a21`), `git diff HEAD` is empty and `git status` is clean.
  - The test imports `../src/commands/init.js`, so no `dist` is on its path.

## Gates (head `4eb2ff4c4`)

- **Derivation.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 84 commands for 5 paths against merge base `425c743fd`.
- **Runs.** Each command was run byte for byte, with its exit code captured before any pipe.
  - First pass: 80 commands exited 0.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage` and `check:i18n-walk-parity` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: no built `dist`).
  - After a full package build (`turbo run build`, 75/75 tasks, under the lock), all four re-ran to exit 0.
- **Reconciliation.** `--ran`: `84 derived, 84 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`, exit 0.
- **Governed surfaces.** `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/issue-25165-scaffold-vitest-advisory`: exit 0, 0 of 5 paths governed, 176 changed lines.
- **The stamp gates.** Both are in the derived set and exited 0: `check:scaffold-emission-policy` (the template and the constant agree) and `check:template-version-sync`.

## Patch round (head `f355f41a2`)

- `origin/main` was merged first (`a22074c89`), then the troubleshooting page was fixed (`f355f41a2`). The diff is now 6 paths against merge base `ab488d9b7`.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derives 112 commands. Each was run with its exit code captured before any pipe, after a full package build (75/75 tasks). All 112 exited 0. `--ran` reports `112 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`, exit 0.
- `check-governed-merges`: 0 of 6 paths governed, 186 changed lines.
- On the merged head, `test/scaffold-npm-overrides.test.ts` passes 12/12 and `create-objectstack` passes 278/278.
- CI on `f355f41a2`: 39 check-runs succeeded and 7 were skipped. They include `Check Documentation Links`, `Build Docs`, `Scaffold outside the monorepo, install, build` and `Check Changeset`.

## Acceptance notes

- **A stale comment.** In `scripts/sync-scaffold-emission-policy.mjs`, the comment on the `devDependencies.vitest` row still says the constant "holds why it is `~4.0.0`". It is a comment outside the file surface, and the script reads the constant's value, not the comment.
- **The remaining audit entries.** A fresh scaffold's other `npm audit` entries all come from GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq on `uuid` 8.x, through `exceljs` `^4.4.0` in the published `@objectstack/rest`. The workspace overrides `uuid` in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, which npm consumers never read. That is not this card.
- **The plugin scaffolds' `npm test`.** `os init -t plugin` and `os create plugin` emit a `test` script but no test file, so `npm test` exits 1 with "No test files found". It does the same on the baseline 4.0.18 (measured on `-t plugin`). That is not this card.
- **origin/main** (`ab488d9b7`) was merged into the branch in the patch round (merge commit `a22074c89`). It had no conflicts.
